clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Durotar, Orgrimmar rises as the New Horde’s warrior capital. Warchief Thrall founded the city in memory of Orgrim Doomhammer, and its red canyons shelter the orcs’ renewal and survival on Kalimdor.

After the Third War and the victory at Mount Hyjal, Warchief Thrall brought his surviving people south to make a homeland in Durotar. Orgrimmar was built among steep mountain crags, with spiked timber walls, stone watchtowers, and caverns cut deep into the mountains. Darkspear trolls, tauren stonemasons, and goblin engineers helped raise the fortress. Its defenses turned the wilderness into a stronghold built to withstand a siege.

Free of the demonic bloodlust that once bound them, the orcs built Orgrimmar as a beacon of honor, community, and survival. Orcs and Darkspear trolls live in the city, while emissaries from the tauren of Mulgore and the newly allied Forsaken are welcomed there. Shamans teach the next generation ancestral balance, and veterans clash in gladiatorial rings to hone the army that guards Kalimdor’s fragile peace.
